title: Banaras Hindu University (BHU): overview and official links
content:
# Banaras Hindu University (BHU): overview and official links

BHU, Varanasi-221005, Uttar Pradesh. Founded in 1916 by Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya with support from Dr Annie Besant, under the B.H.U. Act 1915. Vice-Chancellor: Prof. Ajit Kumar Chaturvedi (per official news items).

## Scale
- 5 institutes, 16 faculties, 135 departments (homepage)
- Main campus about **1,370 acres** with **over 30,000 students** (admission FAQ)
- **Rajiv Gandhi South Campus**, Barkachha, Mirzapur, about 75 km from the main campus
- Affiliated colleges: Arya Mahila PG College, D.A.V. PG College, Vasant Kanya Mahavidyalaya, Vasanta College for Women
- IIT (BHU) is a separate institute.

## Official links
- Main site: https://www.bhu.ac.in · Admissions: https://admission.bhu.ac.in
- SamarthERP student login: https://bhu.samarth.ac.in/index.php/site/login/
- Admitted students portal: https://bhu.samarth.edu.in/index.php/site/login
- Student grievance portal: https://bhu.samarth.ac.in/index.php/pgportal/grievance-public/public
- E-governance ERP: https://erp.bhu.edu.in/
- Controller of Examinations: https://bhu.ac.in/Site/UnitHomeTemplate/1_3255_4727_Controller-of-Examinations-Home
- Placement and Internship Cell: https://www.bhu.ac.in/Site/UnitHomeTemplate/1_3246_4682_Placement-and-Internship-Cell-Home
- Campus news: https://news.bhu.ac.in · Alumni: https://alumni.bhu.ac.in/
- Admission help: admission.help@bhu.ac.in

title: BHU admissions 2026: CUET-based UG and PG, dates and other routes
content:
# BHU admissions 2026: CUET-based UG and PG, dates and other routes

Help: admission.help@bhu.ac.in · FAQ: https://admission.bhu.ac.in/en/faq

## UG (CAP-UG, based on CUET (UG)-2026)
- Admission to all BHU UG programmes is **strictly on the CUET (UG)-2026 score** (NTA sends scores to BHU). Merit uses the normalised score; Class 12 marks are used only to break ties.
- Register at https://bhucuet.samarth.edu.in ('New Registration').
- 2026 notices: UG registration 09/07/2026; CAP UG 11/07/2026; allotment Round 1 01/08/2026, Round 2 06/08/2026, Round 3 12/08/2026, Round 4 17/08/2026; Spot Round 1 26/08/2026.
- Reservation: SC 15%, ST 7.5%, OBC-NCL 27%, EWS 10%, PwBD 5%.

## PG (CAP-PG, based on CUET (PG)-2026)
- Admission strictly on CUET (PG)-2026 scores; also apply on the CAP (PG) portal: https://bhucuetpg.samarth.edu.in. Programme eligibility is in the PG Information Bulletin 2026.
- 2026 notices: CAP PG and PG registration 19/05/2026; Spot Round 1 allocation 18/07/2026; mop-up notification 28/07/2026.
- Fine Arts and Performing Arts: merit combines CUET and a practical test; MPA needs 35% in theory and 45% in practical.

## Other routes
- **Diploma and Certificate Courses (DCC) 2026:** registration live at https://bhuadm.samarth.edu.in/index.php (bulletin notice 20/11/2026).
- **PhD:** Ph.D. Ordinance 2016: https://storage.bhu.ac.in/strapi-media/uploads/Ph_D_Ordinance_2016_e20f7da0fc.pdf; check https://admission.bhu.ac.in/en for the current entrance schedule.
- **Foreign nationals:** apply through the Foreign Students' Registry, https://bhufsradm.samarth.edu.in/2026/ (the portal carries a fraud alert).

**Hostels are not guaranteed:** allotment depends on availability and a merit scale of 80% entrance score + 20% distance.

title: BHU admission fees, refunds, hostel rules and student support
content:
# BHU admission fees, refunds, hostel rules and student support

From the official admission FAQ (https://admission.bhu.ac.in/en/faq). Tuition and hostel fee schedules weren't on the pages read.

## UG (CAP-UG)
| Item | Amount |
| --- | --- |
| CAP-UG registration (General/OBC-NCL/EWS) | ₹500, non-refundable |
| CAP-UG registration (SC/ST/PwBD) | ₹250, non-refundable |
| UG Spot Round fee | ₹1,000, non-refundable |

- Pay each round's admission fee online **within 48 hours of allotment**, or the seat is cancelled.
- Full refund of the admission fee if you withdraw before BHU's last admission date; refunds usually start within three months after admissions close.

## PG (CAP-PG)
| Item | Amount |
| --- | --- |
| Registration (General/OBC/EWS) | ₹300 per programme, non-refundable |
| Registration (SC/ST/PwBD) | ₹150 per programme, non-refundable |
| Regular course fees | approx. ₹1500 (paid seats cost more) |
| PG Spot Round fee | ₹500, non-refundable |

## Hostel
Not guaranteed; allotted by availability on a 100-point scale (80% entrance score + 20% distance).

## Support
- Admission help: admission.help@bhu.ac.in
- Programme grievances go to the Faculty's Admission Committee, through the Dean of the Faculty.
- Grievance portal: https://bhu.samarth.ac.in/index.php/pgportal/grievance-public/public
- An anti-ragging affidavit from the student and a parent is required at admission.
